newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to meet 96/97 profit forecast-president. [CORRECTED 23:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to meet 96/97 profit forecast-president. [CORRECTED 23:45 GMT]

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd president Yoichi Morishita (corrects from Morihito) said on Wednesday the company will be able to achieve its 1996/97 profit forecast.
"Business has been going strongly in the first and second quarters, and is going as we planned," Morishita told a news conference.
"Despite economic uncertainty in the second half of the year, we hope to be able to achieve our business plans and forecast for the full year," he said.
Matsushita said in May it expected to post group net profit of 115 billion yen and parent current profit of 130 billion yen for the year to the end of March 1997.
